decisions.reason: An illuminated candle arch is a core seasonal product for a traditional wood-craft maker, it was featured on the home page and it costs little to keep in the catalog, so the option stays open.
Christmas pyramids are the firm's established line and this one was prominently shown, so keeping it is cheap and its value is consistent with the core business.
The electronic music box is the base platform for the interchangeable motif discs, and add-on editions were released in 2019, which suggests demand and justifies keeping the option.
A second edition was issued, which signals positive results, though licensed motif content carries some risk of expiry, so it is kept with moderate uncertainty.
The Christmas-themed disc fits seasonal demand and adds to the music box platform at low ongoing cost, so it is worth keeping.
A regionally themed Christmas pyramid suits the firm's traditional assortment and was consistently featured, so there is no evidence to justify abandoning it.
